note: Additive correction. The frozen run (result.json) is preserved unmutated; this file records a pre-registration LABEL DEFECT and the corrected reading.

label_defect.what: The pre-registered C2 gate ('MDE non-increasing in L within tol -> PASS') does not distinguish CONSTANT from DECREASING, but the PASS verdict is LABELLED 'mde_decreases_with_budget'.
label_defect.observed: MDE was FLAT at 0.012108 (the p_stay=0.97 world) across L_train in {1500,3000,6000}. It did NOT decrease.
label_defect.consequence: The verdict label overclaims. The honest verdict is 'mde_flat_across_budget__floor_set_by_asymptotic_gap_vs_eps'.

corrected_substantive_finding.headline: For a latent mechanism competing against a flexible observation-only baseline (high-order count table), MORE DATA DOES NOT LOWER the detection floor. Separation is governed by whether the ASYMPTOTIC gap (oracle true_gap) exceeds eps, not by data budget.

evidence.small_data_separation_evaporates: p_stay=0.95 (true_gap 0.0068 < eps 0.01): mean measured gap 0.0101 at L=1500 (power 0.5) converges DOWN toward the true sub-eps value as data grows -> separation collapses. Small-data separations of sub-eps-asymptotic effects are baseline-underestimation artifacts.

confound_caveat.what: At the boundary world p_stay=0.95 the per-seed gap VARIANCE explodes at larger L (sd 0.0028 @1500 -> 0.0276 @3000 -> 0.0299 @6000), with occasional large-negative gaps.
confound_caveat.cause: Partly EM-HMM fit instability (em_restarts=3 insufficient at larger L; occasional bad local optima), NOT pure gap-convergence. So the p_stay=0.95 power drop is part real (gap->sub-eps) and part estimator artifact.
confound_caveat.scope: Confound affects the single boundary world's precise power value; it does NOT affect the qualitative conclusions, which rest on the clean worlds (0.97/0.99 robust; 0.85/0.92 sub-eps).

robust_conclusions: C1 holds: fitted power is monotone non-decreasing in oracle true_gap at every budget (effect-size axis valid).
Worlds with asymptotic true_gap > eps separate robustly at all tested budgets.
Worlds with asymptotic true_gap < eps do not separate robustly at any tested budget.
MDE (smallest reliably-detected true effect) is FLAT across budget and ~= the smallest tested asymptotic gap exceeding eps (~0.012); it is NOT lowered by more data.
A separation found only at small data is not budget-robust and may be a baseline-underestimation false positive.
corrected_power_statement_primitive: A negative/equivalence verdict's power statement is NOT 'collect more data to lower MDE'. It is: 'the loop reliably detects only asymptotic gaps > eps; effects with asymptotic gap < eps are undetectable at ANY budget in this baseline class, and small-data separations of such effects are non-robust'. Positive separations at small data MUST be checked for budget-robustness.
